comments.body: issue (medium): 🟡 **Crop lookup throws when a scene removed its target** **(non-blocking)** `boundingBox()` waits 30 s for an element a scene removed (a dismissed toast, a closed modal), then throws, so `record()` writes no video. A local run did exactly that. Evidence: `skills/design/animations/rules/record-and-iterate.md:86` (crop on the animated element) ```js const box = await page.locator(spec.crop).first().boundingBox({ timeout: 2000 }).catch(() => null); ``` `pr-reviewer` · commit `85c35ed`
